# Swords (skill)

Description: Determines, damage, and, stamina, cost with Swords (skill).

# Introduction

Swords (skill) is a skill related to Swords weapon class.

## Effects

Higher skill level in swords reduces the stamina cost to attack down to -33% and increases damage and knockback up to +141%.
For the details of damage scaling, see Damage mechanics#Skill factor.

## Leveling up

The player gains 1.5xp per attack when hitting a creature.
